description: The beer prices that hold right now in the city's time zone, cheapest per litre first, happy hours and timed promos included: bars' prices in deals, supermarkets' and depósitos' separately in shops. Give lat and lng to keep places within radius_m of a point (each price then carries distance_m). category=bar leaves the shops out.

category.description: Only this kind of place: bar (to drink there), mercado (supermarkets and corner shops) or deposito (drinks shops), the last two to take away; its prices then come in deals. Without it, bars' prices come in deals and shops' prices (at most 5) in shops
